"The Rose Mary Streach"

Also appeared: Miami — 072518-091218 · Miami — 091218-111118
Total entries: 3
MiamiChapter 1Cross-venueHouse-made

Cocktail Ingredients

8 oz Rose wine

2 oz Aperol

2 oz Grapefruit-pineapple oleo

2 oz fresh lemon

Fresh fruit

Prapefruit-Pineapple Oleo

8-10 grapefruits

4 quarts sugar

4 quarts pineapple juice

Technique

Peel grapefruits, add peels to sugar and muddle well to express oils into sugar. cover and let macerate overnight so sugar can continue to pull oils. On the following day add fresh pineapple juice and stirr well to combine until sugar dissolves. Fine strain off solids, quart and refridgreate.

Glassware & Garnish

Served as specified in the original build.

House Made Ingredients

None — no house-made ingredient in this build.

Spirit Descriptions & Substitutions

Aperol — bittersweet orange aperitivo, lighter and sweeter than Campari. Substitution: use another orange aperitivo; Campari will be more bitter, so pull back a touch and add a little sweetness. Wine — in this build it brings acidity and fruit. Substitution: use a fresh, dry wine in the same style; sparkling wine should be fresh and well-chilled.

Recipe Name: Kaffir Lime Bombay

Ingredients List:

Prep Instructions: Blend ingredients in vitamix for 25-30 seconds. Coffee strain and bottle with label.

Spirit Descriptions & Substitutions

Gin — juniper-forward with botanicals, citrus, and spice. London Dry is classic and crisp. Substitution: use a London Dry gin for the classic profile; for a softer build, try a contemporary gin with citrus and floral notes. Aquavit — caraway- and dill-forward Scandinavian spirit. Substitution: use another aquavit; gin with caraway will not match it.

Spirit Descriptions & Substitutions

Gin — juniper-forward with botanicals, citrus, and spice. London Dry is classic and crisp. Substitution: use a London Dry gin for the classic profile; for a softer build, try a contemporary gin with citrus and floral notes. Vermouth — aromatized, fortified wine with herbs and botanicals. Substitution: use a fresh, quality vermouth in the same style (sweet, dry, or blanc) and keep it refrigerated after opening.

Carbonated Coconut Tonic

Technique

Glassware & Garnish

House Made Ingredients

None — no house-made ingredient in this build.

Spirit Descriptions & Substitutions

Tequila — blue agave spirit from Jalisco. Blanco is bright, peppery, and clean; reposado adds oak, vanilla, and caramel. Substitution: swap blanco for blanco and reposado for reposado in the same quality tier; for a smokier take, split the base with mezcal. Vodka — a clean, neutral spirit that lets the modifiers shine. Substitution: any quality unflavored vodka works; a wheat or potato vodka adds a touch more body. Gin — juniper-forward with botanicals, citrus, and spice. London Dry is classic and crisp. Substitution: use a London Dry gin for the classic profile; for a softer build, try a contemporary gin with citrus and floral notes.

Act Naturally

Top with French Cider

Rocks glass, KD ice. Top with French Cider. Garnish Apple Slices

Sarsparilla Pear

2 quarts of Water

4 quarts Sugar

2 large nubs of ginger Chopped

4 Tablespoons Black Peppercorn

1 cup Sarsparilla

3 oz Ginger Juice

Technique

Add Water, Chopped Ginger, and Black Peppercorn in md pot. Bring to a boil then add Sarsparilla. Remove from heat and let steep like tea for around 10 min. Add sugar and return to heat, once sugar has dissolved remove from heat and strain off solids. Finally add 3 oz of Ginger juice and equal parts pear juice. NA.

Spirit Descriptions & Substitutions

Mezcal — a smoky agave spirit from Oaxaca, earthy and complex with notes of smoke, citrus, and roasted agave. Substitution: use another quality mezcal in the same style; for less smoke, split with a blanco tequila, or use a reposado tequila with a whisper of peated whisky. Tequila — blue agave spirit from Jalisco. Blanco is bright, peppery, and clean; reposado adds oak, vanilla, and caramel. Substitution: swap blanco for blanco and reposado for reposado in the same quality tier; for a smokier take, split the base with mezcal. Bourbon — corn-based American whiskey with vanilla, caramel, and oak. Substitution: use a bourbon in the same proof range; a wheated bourbon will be softer, a high-rye bourbon spicier.

Serve milk bottle along with two rocks glasses, one large cube in each glass. garnish cinamon stick and star anise rested on big rock.

Glassware & Garnish

See Technique — glass and garnish are in the build.

House Made Ingredients

Coquito Mix:

  • 5 oz can coconut milk
  • 5 oz Oat Milk
  • 25 oz can condensed coconut milk
  • 4 cinamon sticks
  • 2 star anise pods
  • 3 cloves
  • 1 tsp ground nutmeg

Method: Combine all and bring to a simmer, stir to combine condensed coconut milk. Let simmer for 5-10 min and let steep for an additional 5 min. Transfer to vitamix and blend, fine strain with chinois, lable, and refridgerate.
